campos.descripcion: Icon-only buttons must expose an accessible label
campos.hacer: Set accessibilityLabel or label prop on icon buttons
campos.no_hacer: Icon buttons without accessible names

campos.descripcion: All inputs must have a visible label and an accessibility label
campos.hacer: Pair Text label with input and set accessibilityLabel
campos.no_hacer: Inputs with placeholder only

campos.descripcion: Interactive elements must expose correct roles/traits
campos.hacer: Use accessibilityRole/button/link/checkbox etc.
campos.no_hacer: Rely on generic views with no roles

campos.descripcion: Async status updates should be announced to screen readers
campos.hacer: Use accessibilityLiveRegion or announceForAccessibility
campos.no_hacer: Update text silently with no announcement

campos.descripcion: Decorative icons should be hidden from screen readers
campos.hacer: Mark decorative icons as not accessible
campos.no_hacer: Have screen reader read every icon

campos.palabras_clave: touch target size platform runtime arbitration iOS 44pt Android 48dp web 24 CSS px React Native hitSlop
campos.descripcion: Native targets use 44pt on iOS and 48dp on Android; web WCAG 2.2 has a separate 24 by 24 CSS px minimum with exceptions
campos.hacer: Select 44pt for iOS and 48dp for Android at runtime; evaluate web targets separately against WCAG 2.5.8 and its exceptions
campos.no_hacer: Collapse iOS 44pt, Android 48dp, and web 24 CSS px into one cross-platform number

campos.descripcion: Adjacent touch targets need enough spacing
campos.hacer: Keep at least 8dp spacing between touchables
campos.no_hacer: Cluster many buttons with no gap

campos.descripcion: Custom gestures must not break system scroll/back
campos.hacer: Reserve horizontal swipes for carousels
campos.no_hacer: Full-screen custom swipe conflicting with back

campos.descripcion: Back navigation should be predictable and preserve state
campos.hacer: Use navigation.goBack and keep screen state
campos.no_hacer: Reset stack or exit app unexpectedly

campos.descripcion: Bottom tab bar should have at most 5 primary items
campos.hacer: Use 3–5 tabs and move extras to More/Settings
campos.no_hacer: Overloaded tab bar with many icons

campos.descripcion: Modals/sheets must have clear close actions
campos.hacer: Provide close button and swipe-down where platform expects
campos.no_hacer: Trapping users in modal with no obvious exit

campos.descripcion: Returning to a screen should restore its scroll and form state
campos.hacer: Keep components mounted or persist state
campos.no_hacer: Reset list scroll and form inputs on every visit

campos.descripcion: Show visible feedback during network operations
campos.hacer: Use ActivityIndicator or skeleton for >300ms operations
campos.no_hacer: Leave button and screen frozen

campos.descripcion: Confirm successful actions with brief feedback
campos.hacer: Show toast/checkmark or banner
campos.no_hacer: Complete actions silently with no confirmation

campos.descripcion: Show clear error messages near the problem
campos.hacer: input-level error + summary banner
campos.no_hacer: Only change border color with no explanation

campos.descripcion: Validate inputs on blur or submit with clear messaging
campos.hacer: Validate onBlur and onSubmit
campos.no_hacer: Validate on every keystroke causing jank

campos.descripcion: Use appropriate keyboardType and returnKeyType
campos.hacer: Match email/tel/number/search types
campos.no_hacer: Use default keyboard for all inputs

campos.descripcion: Guide users through form fields with Next/Done flows
campos.hacer: Use onSubmitEditing to focus next input
campos.no_hacer: Force users to tap each field manually

campos.descripcion: Allow toggling password visibility securely
campos.hacer: Provide Show/Hide icon toggling secureTextEntry
campos.no_hacer: Force users to type blind with no option

campos.descripcion: Use FlatList/SectionList for lists over ~50 items
campos.hacer: Use keyExtractor and initialNumToRender appropriately
campos.no_hacer: Render hundreds of items with ScrollView

campos.descripcion: Use correctly sized and cached images
campos.hacer: Use Image component with proper resizeMode and caching
campos.no_hacer: Load full-resolution images everywhere

campos.descripcion: Debounce scroll/search callbacks to avoid jank
campos.hacer: Wrap handlers with debounce/throttle
campos.no_hacer: Run heavy logic on every event

campos.descripcion: Micro-interactions should be 150–300ms with native-like easing
campos.hacer: Use ease-out for enter/ease-in for exit
campos.no_hacer: Use long or linear animations for core UI

campos.descripcion: Respect OS reduced-motion accessibility setting
campos.hacer: Check reduceMotionEnabled and simplify animations
campos.no_hacer: Ignore user motion preferences

campos.descripcion: Reserve infinite animations for loaders and live data
campos.hacer: Use looping only where necessary
campos.no_hacer: Keep decorative elements looping forever

campos.descripcion: Body text must be readable and support Dynamic Type
campos.hacer: Use platform fontScale and at least 14–16pt base
campos.no_hacer: Render critical text below 12pt

campos.descripcion: Support system text scaling without breaking layout
campos.hacer: Set allowFontScaling and test large text
campos.no_hacer: Disable scaling on all text globally

campos.descripcion: Content must not overlap notches/gesture bars
campos.hacer: Wrap screens in SafeAreaView or apply insets
campos.no_hacer: Place tappable content under system bars

campos.descripcion: Ensure sufficient contrast in both light and dark themes
campos.hacer: Use semantic tokens and test both themes
campos.no_hacer: Reuse light-theme grays directly in dark mode

campos.descripcion: Don't rely solely on hidden gestures for core actions
campos.hacer: Provide visible buttons in addition to gestures
campos.no_hacer: Rely on swipe/shake only with no UI affordance

campos.palabras_clave: accessible drag interaction drag single pointer alternative keyboard drag alternative reorder resize move buttons React Native native runtime platform router arbitration iOS Android web
campos.descripcion: React Native drag and reorder operations need a non-drag path selected for the active native runtime
campos.hacer: Provide named Move up/down buttons or a position menu beside drag handles; route iOS and Android behavior through the runtime platform adapter
campos.no_hacer: Make drag, swipe, or a web-only pointer handler the only way to reorder native content

campos.palabras_clave: password manager passkey paste redundant entry
campos.descripcion: Authentication and multi-step flows should reuse prior values
campos.hacer: Support password managers passkeys paste and prefilled confirmed values
campos.no_hacer: Force users to retype credentials or the same data in one flow
